# Clubhouse Bridge map

<!-- Generated by node scripts/clubhouse/registry.mjs sync. Do not edit; edit the sources under config/clubhouse/ and docs/clubhouse/catalog/. -->

Every Bridge ID (D-68: namespace, two-digit category, two-digit item), its catalog code and its meaning. IDs are permanent; retired ones move to `config/clubhouse/bridge-tombstones.json`.

## How catalog kinds become categories

`config/clubhouse/category-map.json`. A row takes its kind's default unless it is listed as an exception.

| Catalog kind | Default category |
| --- | --- |
| 0 Error toast | 06 Server / system error |
| 1 Validation | 05 Validation |
| 2 Didn't load | 06 Server / system error |
| 3 Empty | 04 Empty |
| 4 Loading | 02 Initial loading / skeleton |
| 5 Confirm | 11 Destructive |
| 6 Motion | 16 Micro animation |
| 7 Haptic | 17 Haptic |
| 8 Accessibility | 18 Accessibility |
| 9 Network and UX | 07 Network / offline |

| Exception | Category | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |

| CH-7015 | 08 Permission / authorization | The open conversation is no longer the caller's to see (left, or another team's). |
